title_zh: 为跑步体验选择先绕跑道走一圈

scenario.label_zh: 为跑步体验选择先绕跑道走一圈
scenario.goal_zh: 了解新参加者希望平缓开始的意愿，并约定先走一圈再由本人决定是否慢跑

context_zh: 英式英语场景。社区跑步社团教练接待一位成年新参加者，双方讨论当日体验路线。
author: author-phase11-b

sentences.speaker: Gareth
sentences.text: Are you the lad who emailed about our beginner session? I'm Gareth.

sentences.speaker: Evan
sentences.text: Yes, I'm Evan. I've brought trainers, but I'd like to start gently.

sentences.speaker: Gareth
sentences.text: My first instinct was to show you the woodland path, but it's muddy today.

sentences.speaker: Evan
sentences.text: I'd rather not leap over puddles on my first morning. Could we use the track?

sentences.speaker: Gareth
sentences.text: Certainly. We can walk one lap together, then you can decide whether you want to try a little jogging.

sentences.speaker: Evan
sentences.text: That suits me. One walking lap first, and I'll see how I feel.

sentences.speaker: Gareth
sentences.text: Good. There's no need to match anyone else's pace.
